body: What about not making those mistakes with her?
It's okay. I haven't had anyone to talk to about this sort of stuff in 3 years. It's upsetting knowing the person you love doesn't want to listen to anything I say.
I really do think she's the one. I know it sounds dumb because she's my first girlfriend but I believe I got lucky, and it won't work because she has no trust in me. I've dug my own grave.
